title: The Mountain Range That Accidentally Froze Earth
description: Discover how the tectonic rise of the Himalayas acted as a massive planetary vacuum, sucking carbon from the atmosphere and plunging Earth into the ice ages.
instagram_caption:
Did you know a mountain range could literally change Earth's climate? 🏔️ When the Himalayas rose, they acted as a colossal carbon vacuum, scrubbing greenhouse gases from the air and triggering the modern ice ages! 🌍❄️ 

Follow Wonders of the Nature for more amazing Earth history secrets!

segments.narration: A colossal mountain range once acted as a giant vacuum cleaner, literally sucking greenhouse gases right out of the sky.

segments.narration: Fifty million years ago, India's violent collision with Asia thrust the Himalayas upward, exposing massive fields of fresh rock to carbon-rich monsoon rains.

segments.narration: This acidic rainwater dissolved the newly exposed stone, trapping the carbon in minerals that rushing rivers swept safely into the ocean floor.
